ipxact:component.ipxact:name: efx_bram
ipxact:component.ipxact:description: The BRAM Wrapper core provides the generation of Single-port RAM, Simple Dual-port RAM, True Dual-port RAM, Single-port ROM and Dual-port ROM for any application requiring memory storage. The core provides an optimized solution using the block RAM in Trion® and Titanium® FPGAs.
